profile.headline: Blockchain Full Stack Software Engineer at dClimate
profile.summary:
Highly motivated Software Developer offering over 8 years of work experience in different fields.
Passionate about technology, mainly Software Developing, Security and Blockchain. 
Ambitious, hardworking and constant and never giving up on his goals until reaching them.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Developing automated test cases and adding new functionalities to testing framework of the company for uncovering, identifying, and documenting software problems easily and faster. 
• Executing automated and manual Regression and Functional test cases for different functionalities dependent on third party companies across different services both REST and SOAP (calls, mobile notifications, sms’s)
• Helping to migrate software development to a Test Driven-Development process
• Skills: Java, Cucumber

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developing new functionalities for personal financial management website myvalue.com (around 9000 monthly visitors) in the backend and developing the user interface for showing the data of these new functionalities and applying new styles. 
• Developing new functionalities for personal financial management mobile applications “Tus Gastos” and “MyValue” (iOS) with more than 5000 downloads
• Developing business financial management tools and personal financial management tools for different banks of Spain.
• Skills: Java, Spring, JavaScript, jQuery, Objective-C, MySQL, HTML 5, CSS 3

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developing iOS application with Swift for locating blind people inside closed rooms 
using Bluetooth and beacons and informing them about what they had around. 
Also maintaining and improving the website of the project
• Working with blind people users for obtaining feedback for improving the application
• Skills: Swift, WordPress, HTML 5, CSS 3

projects.title: Urbateck
projects.description: Application for managing the transport of materials construction works (AWS, React Native)

projects.title: Auction DAPP with Ethereum using ZK-SNARKS (Solidity, Truffle, ReactJS)
projects.description: Project which ensures not only the trust on the auctioneer and the correctness of the process for obtaining the winner of the auction in an First-Price Sealed Bid Auction (FPSBA), but also maintains the privacy remaining private the bids of the bidders who took part in the auction, emulating a First-price sealed-bid Auctions.
